style: Minimal brand lockup. Solid black wordmark, pure alpha background, no decoration — the 3D spin is the entire motif. Confident, punchy, dance-studio energy.
font: Anton (B16, bold condensed) + Archivo (DANCE STUDIO, wide-tracked)

scenes.motion: rotate_y_settle — hand-authored gap (catalog search-miss logged): lockup spins in place around the vertical (Y) axis, two full turns decelerating into a forward-facing hold; no positional movement, rotation only

notes.source: Recreated as live HTML/CSS text from the B16 Dance Studio logo (not a raster cutout) — this session's Adobe background-removal cutout only captured "B16" (subject-select dropped "DANCE STUDIO"), and the environment's egress policy blocks downloading the Adobe-hosted PNG into this project anyway. Live text also renders sharp at any rotation angle, unlike a raster cutout which would alias under 3D perspective.
notes.catalog_search_miss: npx hyperframes feedback --search-miss "3D horizontal rotation spin text logo in place" logged — no registry block does an in-place rotateY spin-and-settle for a wordmark.
